## RE:volution Mod v2.0.0

### ZBT milestone

This release marks the project as ready for closed beta testing (ZBT). Balance numbers remain ZBT Draft, not Final.

### Added

- Replaced the vanilla survival presentation with an RPG-oriented client flow.
- `E` now opens the RE:volution main menu instead of the vanilla inventory.
- Added a compact custom RPG HUD with synchronized resources at the bottom center and final click/poison damage values at the top left.
- Added a dedicated system notification feed with up to three visible messages instead of routing RE:volution system logs through normal chat.
- Added server-side survival guards so RPG players cannot take damage, break blocks, or run out of food while remaining in Survival mode.
- Added poison-based managed-mob combat pause using the same stop behavior as direct click damage.
- Added distributed fixed mob placement for Control/Admin population changes.

### Changed

- Disabled conflicting vanilla Inventory and Advancements keybinds on the client.
- Disabled the vanilla attack cooldown indicator.
- Hid vanilla hotbar, hearts, hunger and experience HUD elements for RPG Survival players.
- Moved RE:volution keybind hints and Realm information to the lower-right HUD area.
- Moved system purchase/enhancement notifications to the right-side notification area.
- Dimmed managed-mob HP bar colors and alpha for a less intrusive presentation.
- Rune purchase buttons now disable when the player cannot afford the full selected `x1/x5/x10/x100` purchase cost.
- Player-facing managed-mob reward labels now use localized resource names: Rune Dust, Rune Shards and Rune Cores display as `Пыль рун`, `Осколки рун`, and `Ядра рун` in the Russian client presentation.
- Population normalization now consistently uses `fixed=floor(n/2)` and `random=ceil(n/2)`, with the odd remainder assigned to random slots.

### Fixed

- Fixed Control/Admin population updates cloning the same fixed spawn coordinates and stacking fixed mobs at the stage center.
- Fixed hunger runtime handling that previously called an incompatible FoodStats saturation method on the dedicated 1.12.2 server runtime.

### Other

- Existing ZBT balance numbers remain Draft and are not finalized by this release.
- Rune purchase curves, duplicate compensation, rank-up costs, unlimited enhancement policy, Rune Rank Revert policy and Location 1 balance are unchanged.
- Mongo schema and Balance Core schema version are unchanged.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifacts published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.5.2...v2.0.0
